_from: docs/plans/stories/PLAN.md. Story paintings for trader: one 1536x864 scene a page, filed as art/story/<story id>-<page>.webp. The captain face is laid over the corner in the game, so leave the bottom-left quiet.

styles.a: Painterly sci-fi storybook illustration, deep space blues and purples with glowing planets and warm cockpit light, cinematic, hopeful and friendly, suitable for children aged 8 to 12, no writing, no letters, no numbers, no logos anywhere.

pictures.name: trader-opening-1
pictures.prompt: A child at a bedroom window at night looking up at a sky full of stars and one big glowing moon, a toy rocket on the windowsill. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: trader-opening-2
pictures.prompt: A busy future spaceport hangar, and in a dusty corner a small scruffy rusty spaceship with patched panels, cheap but lovable, warm hangar lights. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: trader-opening-3
pictures.prompt: Inside a small cosy spaceship cockpit, a cute little round helper robot with big glowing blue eyes blinking awake on the dashboard, stars outside the window. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: trader-opening-4
pictures.prompt: A small cargo spaceship flying between a green farm planet with crop fields and a grey factory planet with glowing chimneys, cargo crates floating in the hold. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: trader-opening-5
pictures.prompt: Deep space with floating junk and asteroid rocks, a cartoonish pirate spaceship with a skull-free flag-shaped fin in the distance, a small ship dodging. Exciting, not scary. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: trader-opening-6
pictures.prompt: A small spaceship flying towards a beautiful glowing silver moon, golden sparkles around it, a big starry sky, hopeful and grand. Landscape, wide.
